'''Arvel Crynyd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Green Leader/Legends|leader]] of the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]]-filled [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Three of them coming in, twenty degrees!|Arvel Crynyd|<ref name="rotj" />}}
[[File:ArvelCrynyd.png|thumb|left|100px|Arvel Crynyd during the Galactic Civil War]]
During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], Crynyd led his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] into the fleet of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] with the objective of disabling their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] on three Star Destroyers, thereby allowing [[Home One/Legends|Home One]] and the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] through to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="RSIII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>

At the climax of the battle, he was leading a strafing run of key locations on the ''Executor'' where he attempted to perform a [[Trench Run Defense|trench run]] and took out several turbolasers<ref name="RSIII" /> before point-blank fire struck the left side of his [[Green Squadron 1|A-wing]], sending it into a spin. Knowing that his fighter was critically damaged, Crynyd managed to regain enough control of his starfighter to sacrifice himself as he [[Ramming/Legends|flew it]] into the [[Deflector shield/Legends|unshielded]] bridge of ''Executor''. The wedge shaped fighter penetrated the bridge and its large fuel reserve ignited in a fireball that annihilated the command tower, killing Crynyd, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] and the entire bridge crew instantly.<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> With control lost, and in the middle of a battle maneuver, the mighty [[Warship/Legends|warship]] crashed into the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], thus turning the tide of the battle.<ref name="rotj" />

===Legacy===
[[File:StillObviouslyACar-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|250px|Crynyd crashes into the bridge of the Super Star Destroyer ''Executor''.]]
He was posthumously awarded the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]], which was one of the New Republic's most prestigious honors. In addition to this, a new award for acts of conspicuous bravery during space-to-space fighting was created to honor him, known as the [[Crynyd Award]]. An [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] captured at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]] was also renamed ''[[Crynyd]]'' in his memory.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Green Leader!''"<br />"''Copy, Gold Leader.''"<br />"''Split off and head back to the surface&mdash;Home-one just called for a fighter, and you might draw some fire off us.|Lando Calrissian and Green Leader in the ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization|<ref name="Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi (novel)">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Mad_Maxx_storyboard_ROTJ.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Storyboard art of "Mad Maxx"]]
Arvel Crynyd was played by [[Hilton McRae]] in an uncredited performance in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Hilton McRae 1">{{WebCite|url=http://aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=11773|text=Hilton McRae|work=Aveleyman|archivedate=20130429000650}}</ref><ref name="Hilton McRae 2">{{WebCite|url=http://let-the-wookie-win.com/index.php?showimage=535|text=My Hilton McRae Star Wars Autograph|work=SW Autograph Collecting|archivedate=20131114003323}}</ref> He should not be confused with [[Sila Kott/Legends|Sila Kott]], a similar-looking A-wing pilot who was played by a woman but whose lines were dubbed by a man.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28138124|board=Literature|thread=Female pilots and the like|user=[[Pablo Hidalgo|Pabawan]]|date=2008-02-28|time=12:26 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171026102028/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/female-pilots-and-the-like.28135771}}</ref> However, Crynyd's line "Three of them coming in, twenty degrees!" is attributed to "[[Red Three/Legends|Red Three]]" in ''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''. His dying scream is simply attributed to a "Rebel pilot."<ref name="Annotated Screenplays ">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> His nickname during the production of the film was "Mad Maxx" — an homage to the film ''Mad Max'' — as seen in storyboards for the film.<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

Crynyd was incorrectly referred to as "[[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]]" in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', specifically the bonus mission to bring down the ''Executor'', because the game reused sound clips of other wingmen in the game. In the same mission, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] addresses him simply as "Pilot". In the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]], Crynyd (as Green Leader) takes the place of Green Squadron pilot [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]], who follows [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] into the Death Star before heading back to the surface in order to draw TIE fighters away.<ref name="ROTJ novel chapter IX">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]], chapter IX</ref>

[[File:JakeFarrell-TLC.jpg|thumb|Hilton McRae's likeness, identified as Jake Farrell, used on the package of Farrell's ''The Legacy Collection'' action figure.]]
Crynyd's name was erroneously applied to an action figure actually based on Rebel pilot [[Telsij/Legends|Telsij]] in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''The Power of the Force'']] collection. In [[2008]] he received a proper figure, packaged with his A-wing as part of [[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|''The Legacy Collection'']]. The likeness of Hilton McRae was also used as the portrait of [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]] at the package of ''The Legacy Collection''.
